source.title: Rendi resilienti i servizi Fedora e monitora ciascuno in Kuma

prompt_metadata.explanation: Controlla i programmi automatici che devono restare sempre attivi sul tuo Fedora. Se uno si ferma, lo fa ripartire e fa comparire il problema in Uptime Kuma.

analyses.summary: FAIL reale ma circoscritto: il runtime non esponeva autorevolmente i path amministrativi Uptime Kuma, quindi Codex ha correttamente evitato una write DB non sicura. fedora-system-monitor/main ora espone 'kuma-runtime --json' con helper Oracle, directory Compose, DB live e template backup; commit daef956d CI PASS. Il residuo viene trasferito a 815274 senza ripetere inventario/hardening.

status_history.note: Latest execution ended FAIL. Concrete blocker: canonical Kuma DB/backup paths were not exposed by FSM tooling; root cause is now fixed remotely and a bounded follow-up replaces the residual work.

work_item_dependencies.note: General Fedora service reconciliation should run after credential-boundary libsecret cutover to avoid duplicate runtime edits.
Run the Discord-specific always-on/Kuma repair first; the general service sweep then covers the remaining services without duplicating its specialized data-safety work.
General service inventory should run after the already-implemented Context Index is installed so its service/timer is included in the live reconciliation.
